scope: Avoid full-plate snapshots on non-projection preview loads and reuse immutable projection snapshots
checks: no full-population iteration when projection is off
one snapshot reused per unchanged population when projection is on
every sampler rescan/invalidation replaces snapshot identity
actual old/new TIFF projections match their queued immutable snapshots
stale callbacks do not overwrite the latest preview
existing 98304-file timing guard passes with unchanged 15ms ceiling
